$comment: Backdrop layout (02-world-maps.md section 4.3; M02b1). The atlas texture/far-bay-cards is 2048 x 1024 with 8 columns (one per cluster) and 3 rows (azimuths W, SW, NW) of 256 x 341 px cards (BD-M02a2-09). A card stands at the true bearing of its cluster, at the true distance clamped to the tier's card distance, and shows the row whose azimuth is nearest to the direction from the card to the spawn. Cluster positions are lat/lng converted with the C08 constants. M10d2: the atlas is rasterised by bake S11 (tools/map/src/far/raster.ts) from the far DEM, with a seeded ridge of `ridgeM` where the bake has no far terrain under a cluster, and seeded massing (`towers` up to `towerMaxM`, `houses`); `heightM` is the card's vertical extent in metres. The 24-card cap (8 clusters x 3 azimuths) keeps 8 of the 10 clusters of the spec; Brisbane-SFO and the Peninsula stay on the DEM ring of the desktop tiers (BD-M10d2-03).
